seo.title: Front-End Engineer & UI/UX Designer
seo.description: Giancarlos Garza builds high-performance interfaces, offline-first platforms and design systems with Vue, Nuxt and TypeScript.
seo.ogTitle: Giancarlos Garza, Front-End Engineer and UI/UX Designer
seo.ogDescription: High-performance interfaces, offline-first platforms and design systems built with Vue, Nuxt and TypeScript.

p01.description: Color and design tools that run in the browser, with real-time contrast checks and two npm libraries of its own for UI and CSS.

p02.description: Touch-screen kiosks for corporate dining that keep working without internet, with multi-tenant support and shift-based access.

p03.description: A live map with each vehicle's location and status, refreshed every few seconds without the browser slowing down.

p04.tagline: Smart access control & community management platform
p04.description: For gated communities: WhatsApp QR passes, a photo of every entry at the guard booth, plate recognition and dues collection, all in one system.

p05.tagline: Healthcare operations & clinical ERP web app
p05.description: A clinic system: patient records, scheduling, automatic per-service billing and multi-level financial approvals.

p06.description: For caterers: instant quotes, bookings and an interface that works the same at the office and on site.

performance.title: Performance by design
performance.text: I measure speed from the first commit, not at the end: lean SSR, performance budgets and Core Web Vitals from day one.

systems.title: Systems over screens
systems.text: Design tokens, component libraries and reusable patterns instead of one-off fixes, so the product stays consistent as it grows.

designInCode.title: Design in code
designInCode.text: I design in the browser: semantic HTML, motion and real states (hover, loading, error) tested where people will actually see them.

colorffyUi.text: Headless Vue 3 component library with 70+ typed components.

colorffyCss.text: SCSS framework with a tonal color system, utilities and layout grid.

colorffyWorkspace.text: Open-source monorepo where both libraries are designed and built.
